```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# load libaries
library(tidyverse)
```

Read in microbiome data 
```{r}
# read in each relative abundance table - one for each taxonomic level
king <- read.csv("../data/derived/RelAbun/RelAbun_king.csv")
phyl <- read.csv("../data/derived/RelAbun/RelAbun_phyl.csv")
class <- read.csv("../bewell/data/derived/RelAbun/RelAbun_class.csv")
ord <- read.csv("../data/derived/RelAbun/RelAbun_ord.csv")
fam <- read.csv("../data/derived/RelAbun/RelAbun_fam.csv")
gen <- read.csv("../data/derived/RelAbun/RelAbun_gen.csv")
spec <- read.csv("../data/derived/RelAbun/RelAbun_spec.csv")
```
Combine into one dataframe
```{r}
# create list of dataframe names
df_list <- list(king, phyl, class, ord, fam, gen, spec)

# merge and rename subject ID variable 
taxa <- df_list %>% reduce(full_join, by='X') %>%
  rename("Sample" = X)
```

Read in long form sample key
```{r}
samplabs <- read.csv("../data/derived/timepoint_key_long.csv") 
```

Merge sample key and microbiome data 
```{r}
taxa_samps <- merge(samplabs, taxa)
```


## EXAMPLE: comobine microbiome data with some other variable

read in data
```{r}
demographics <- read.csv("../data/derived/BEWELL demographics.csv")
```

merge by 'Subject.ID'
```{r}
combined <- merge(demographics, taxa_samps)
```
